job.job_description:
Junior AI Engineer (2 4 Years Experience)

Role Summary:
Support the design, development, and deployment of AI/GenAI solutions, working closely with senior engineers to build scalable and reliable systems.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assist in building and deploying AI/ML and GenAI applications (RAG, chatbots, automation tools)
- Develop and maintain APIs using Python/Node.js (FastAPI, Flask, etc.)
- Work on data preprocessing, embeddings, and basic vector search implementations
- Support ingestion pipelines and data workflows
- Participate in prompt engineering, testing, and evaluation activities
- Contribute to debugging, monitoring, and performance optimization
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on feature delivery

Required Skills:
- 2 4 years of experience in software engineering or AI/ML roles
- Proficiency in Python (preferred) or JavaScript/TypeScript
- Basic understanding of LLMs, RAG, and AI application development
- Familiarity with APIs, microservices, and databases (SQL/NoSQL)
- Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
- Strong problem-solving and learning mindset

Preferred Skills:
- Experience with tools like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks
- Understanding of Docker and basic CI/CD practices
- Exposure to vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)



Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
